title: How I Diagnose a Broken CRM/Email Automation

sections.label: 1 · DIAGNOSE
sections.note: I isolate the exact point of failure before touching anything, trigger, condition, or action.

sections.label: 2 · FIX & CONFIRM
sections.note: The fix goes exactly where the diagnosis pointed, then gets proven with a real test run.

nodes.label: Confirm the Exact Symptom: No Email, Wrong Sequence, Stuck Contact, or Bad Condition
Check Whether the Automation Trigger Actually Fired
Check Every Condition or Filter on the Failing Step
Check the Action Itself: Email Send, Stage Move, or Sequence Assignment
Isolate the Root Cause: Trigger, Condition, or Action
Apply the Fix at the Exact Point of Failure
Re-Run the Automation End to End With a Test Contact
Confirm the Fix Holds Before Handing It Back

input_sample.reported_symptom: New leads from the contact form aren't getting the welcome email
input_sample.condition_check: welcome sequence has a filter requiring 'source = website', form leads are tagged 'source = web' instead
input_sample.root_cause: condition mismatch on the source field value

output_sample.fix_applied: corrected the filter to accept both 'website' and 'web' tag values
output_sample.test_result: test contact received the welcome email within 2 minutes
